Method of Attack: Ransomware distribution via affiliates infecting victims' computers
Demanding ransom payments for decrypting infected computers
Use of darknet admin panel for managing ransomware botnet to remain anonymous
Affiliate revenue sharing model with ransomware developers

Attack Vector: Infection through ransomware distribution by affiliates
Access to admin panel via darknet

Master decryption keys released by FBI
